title: Nonnegativity of noise sensitivity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $0\leq\delta\leq1$. The probability that $f$ changes when each coordinate of a uniformly chosen input is independently flipped with probability $\delta$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs
